scope: One bounded local verification run against the Entroly repository checkout
limitations: This is a reproducible proof run, not a worldwide or all-user savings total.
The verifier bounds indexing for a safe first-run smoke test; files_indexed is the measured denominator.
Modeled USD excludes output tokens, cache pricing, subscriptions, local compute and provider-specific billing adjustments.
Each installation's all-time totals come from its local Context Value Receipt via entroly value or entroly dashboard.
